## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the observed need and the change. Explain why native capabilities or the
current kit did not already handle it.

## Evidence

State checks actually run and their results. For instruction or trigger changes,
include an applicable task and an ordinary task that should proceed directly.
Label static checks, native loading tests, and behavior comparisons separately.

## Costs and limits

Mention any new context, maintenance, or tool-specific assumptions. Keep both
READMEs aligned when setup, public claims, or supported scope changes.
